sentences.text_target: We often experience a sudden shift in temperature during this unpredictable season.
sentences.phonetic: /wi ˈɒf.ən ɪkˈspɪə.ri.əns ə ˈsʌd.ən ʃɪft ɪn ˈtem.prə.tʃər ˈdjʊə.rɪŋ ðɪs ˌʌn.prɪˈdɪk.tə.bəl ˈsiː.zən/
sentences.text_native: Nous connaissons souvent un changement soudain de température pendant cette saison imprévisible.

sentences.text_target: The thermometer can drop significantly within just a few hours.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə θəˈmɒm.ɪ.tər kən drɒp sɪɡˈnɪf.ɪ.kənt.li wɪˈðɪn dʒʌst ə fjuː aʊəz/
sentences.text_native: Le thermomètre peut chuter de manière significative en quelques heures seulement.

sentences.text_target: Yesterday, I had to pack a heavy suitcase for a short vacation.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈjes.tə.deɪ, aɪ hæd tuː pæk ə ˈhev.i ˈsuːt.keɪs fɔːr ə ʃɔːt vəˈkeɪ.ʃən/
sentences.text_native: Hier, j'ai dû faire une lourde valise pour de courtes vacances.

sentences.text_target: My destination was a remote wooden cabin in the mountains.
sentences.phonetic: /maɪ ˌdes.tɪˈneɪ.ʃən wɒz ə rɪˈməʊt ˈwʊd.ən ˈkæb.ɪn ɪn ðə ˈmaʊn.tɪnz/
sentences.text_native: Ma destination était un chalet en bois isolé dans les montagnes.

sentences.text_target: When I left my house, the morning was quite sunny and pleasant.
sentences.phonetic: /wen aɪ left maɪ haʊs, ðə ˈmɔː.nɪŋ wɒz kwaɪt ˈsʌn.i ənd ˈplez.ənt/
sentences.text_native: Quand j'ai quitté ma maison, la matinée était plutôt ensoleillée et agréable.

sentences.text_target: However, the weather forecast predicted a major change for the afternoon.
sentences.phonetic: /haʊˈev.ər, ðə ˈweð.ə ˈfɔː.kɑːst prɪˈdɪk.tɪd ə ˈmeɪ.dʒər tʃeɪndʒ fɔːr ði ˈɑːf.tə.nuːn/
sentences.text_native: Cependant, les prévisions météo annonçaient un changement majeur pour l'après-midi.

sentences.text_target: I put my warm jacket and gloves inside the car.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ pʊt maɪ wɔːm ˈdʒæk.ɪt ənd ɡlʌvz ɪnˈsaɪd ðə kɑːr/
sentences.text_native: J'ai mis ma veste chaude et mes gants à l'intérieur de la voiture.

sentences.text_target: During the drive, the landscape transformed completely.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈdjʊə.rɪŋ ðə draɪv, ðə ˈlænd.skeɪp trænsˈfɔːmd kəmˈpliːt.li/
sentences.text_native: Pendant le trajet, le paysage s'est transformé complètement.

sentences.text_target: A thick grey cloud covered the bright sky very quickly.
sentences.phonetic: /ə θɪk ɡreɪ klaʊd ˈkʌv.ərd ðə braɪt skaɪ ˈver.i ˈkwɪk.li/
sentences.text_native: Un épais nuage gris a couvert le ciel lumineux très rapidement.

sentences.text_target: Then, a foggy mist appeared in the valley below.
sentences.phonetic: /ðen, ə ˈfɒɡ.i mɪst əˈpɪəd ɪn ðə ˈvæl.i bɪˈləʊ/
sentences.text_native: Ensuite, une brume épaisse est apparue dans la vallée en bas.

sentences.text_target: I had to be extremely careful because the road became very slippery.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ hæd tuː biː ɪkˈstriːm.li ˈkeə.fəl bɪˈkɒz ðə rəʊd bɪˈkeɪm ˈver.i ˈslɪp.ər.i/
sentences.text_native: Je devais être extrêmement prudent car la route est devenue très glissante.

sentences.text_target: Raindrops started hitting the windshield without warning.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈreɪn.drɒps ˈstɑː.tɪd ˈhɪt.ɪŋ ðə ˈwɪnd.ʃiːld wɪˈðaʊt ˈwɔː.nɪŋ/
sentences.text_native: Des gouttes de pluie ont commencé à frapper le pare-brise sans avertissement.

sentences.text_target: Soon, a strong thunderstorm developed with loud thunder.
sentences.phonetic: /suːn, ə strɒŋ ˈθʌ.də.stɔːm dɪˈvel.əpt wɪð laʊd ˈθʌn.dər/
sentences.text_native: Bientôt, un fort orage s'est développé avec de violents thunders.

sentences.text_target: I turned on the windshield wipers immediately.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ tɜːnd ɒn ðə ˈwɪnd.ʃiːld ˈwaɪ.pərz ɪˈmiː.di.ət.li/
sentences.text_native: J'ai immédiatement actionné les essuie-glaces.

sentences.text_target: When I finally reached my destination, I felt relieved.
sentences.phonetic: /wen aɪ ˈfaɪ.nəl.i riːtʃt maɪ ˌdes.tɪˈneɪ.ʃən, aɪ felt rɪˈliːvd/
sentences.text_native: Quand j'ai enfin atteint ma destination, je me suis senti soulagé.

sentences.text_target: I opened the wooden door and stepped inside.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ ˈəʊ.pənd ðə ˈwʊd.ən dɔːr ənd stept ɪnˈsaɪd/
sentences.text_native: J'ai ouvert la porte en bois et suis entré.

sentences.text_target: The cabin was cold, so I needed to gather some wood.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈkæb.ɪn wɒz kəʊld, səʊ aɪ ˈniː.dɪd tuː ˈɡæð.ər sʌm wʊd/
sentences.text_native: Le chalet était froid, alors j'ai dû ramasser du bois.

sentences.text_target: I built a warm fire in the old stone fireplace.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ bɪlt ə wɔːm ˈfaɪər ɪn ði əʊld stəʊn ˈfaɪə.pleɪs/
sentences.text_native: J'ai allumé un feu chaleureux dans la vieille cheminée en pierre.

sentences.text_target: The dancing flames brought a very cozy atmosphere to the room.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈdɑːn.sɪŋ fleɪmz brɔːt ə ˈver.i ˈkəʊ.zi ˈæt.məs.fɪər tuː ðə ruːm/
sentences.text_native: Les flammes dansantes ont apporté une atmosphère très douillette à la pièce.

sentences.text_target: While the storm raged outside, I prepared a hot drink.
sentences.phonetic: /waɪl ðə stɔːm reɪdʒd ˈaʊt.saɪd, aɪ prɪˈpeəd ə hɒt drɪŋk/
sentences.text_native: Pendant que la tempête faisait rage dehors, j'ai préparé une boisson chaude.

sentences.text_target: I cooked a delicious vegetable soup on the small stove.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ kʊkt ə dɪˈlɪʃ.əs ˈvedʒ.tə.bəl suːp ɒn ðə smɔːl stəʊv/
sentences.text_native: J'ai préparé une délicieuse soupe de légumes sur le petit poêle.

sentences.text_target: The kitchen smelled wonderful with all those spices.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈkɪtʃ.ən smeld ˈwʌn.dər.fəl wɪð ɔːl ðəʊz ˈspaɪ.sɪz/
sentences.text_native: La cuisine embaumait avec toutes ces épices.

sentences.text_target: Later that evening, I sat in a comfortable armchair with a good book.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈleɪ.tər ðæt ˈiːv.nɪŋ, aɪ sæt ɪn ə ˈkʌm.fə.tə.bəl ˈɑːm.tʃeər wɪð ə ɡʊd bʊk/
sentences.text_native: Plus tard dans la soirée, je me suis assis dans un fauteuil confortable avec un bon livre.

sentences.text_target: By midnight, the heavy rain stopped completely.
sentences.phonetic: /baɪ ˈmɪd.naɪt, ðə ˈhev.i reɪn stɒpt kəmˈpliːt.li/
sentences.text_native: Vers minuit, la forte pluie s'est complètement arrêtée.

sentences.text_target: The next morning brought a completely different kind of weather.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə nekst ˈmɔː.nɪŋ brɔːt ə kəmˈpliːt.li ˈdɪf.ər.ənt kaɪnd ɒv ˈweð.ər/
sentences.text_native: Le lendemain matin offrait un temps complètement différent.

sentences.text_target: A white frost covered the green grass in the yard.
sentences.phonetic: /ə waɪt frɒst ˈkʌv.ərd ðə ɡriːn ɡrɑːs ɪn ðə jɑːd/
sentences.text_native: Une gelée blanche recouvrait l'herbe verte dans la cour.

sentences.text_target: The air felt exceptionally fresh when I stepped outside to breathe.
sentences.phonetic: /ði eər felt ɪkˈsep.ʃən.əl.i freʃ wen aɪ stept ˈaʊt.saɪd tuː briːð/
sentences.text_native: L'air était exceptionnellement frais lorsque je suis sorti pour respirer.

sentences.text_target: I checked my schedule and prepared my hiking equipment.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ tʃekt maɪ ˈsked.juːl ənd prɪˈpeəd maɪ ˈhaɪ.kɪŋ ɪˈkwɪp.mənt/
sentences.text_native: J'ai vérifié mon programme et préparé mon équipement de randonnée.

sentences.text_target: The bright sun began to shine through the tall trees.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə braɪt sʌn bɪˈɡæn tuː ʃaɪn θruː ðə tɔːl triːz/
sentences.text_native: Le soleil éclatant a commencé à briller à travers les grands arbres.

sentences.text_target: It was a wonderful weekend to explore nature after the storm.
sentences.phonetic: /ɪt wɒz ə ˈwʌn.dər.fəl ˈwiːk.end tuː ɪkˈsplɔːr ˈneɪ.tʃər ˈɑːf.tər ðə stɔːm/
sentences.text_native: C'était un week-end merveilleux pour explorer la nature après la tempête.
